newsitem.title: LATVIA: OTC VOLUME BEATS OFFICIAL MARKET LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: OTC VOLUME BEATS OFFICIAL MARKET LAST WEEK.

text.p: Riga stock exchange said on Monday that during the first week of April the volume of the over-the-counter market reached 2.48 million lats, more than three times the official market of 680,142 lats.
Lode Brick, a secondary list stock, had most of the OTC volume or 1.23 million lats of shares and Daugavpils Chain factory followed with 491,307 lats of shares.
Rigas Transport Fleet saw 487,920 lats of shares traded on the free market and fellow official list stock Unibanka registered volume of 150,838 lats.
All four companies were also among the top six most-traded stocks on the bourse's official list.
